The 30 'conversions' are IDX forced registrations, not qualified leads. Budget is pacing at 3.6x the stated target.

projectedImpact.explanation: By fixing geo-targeting (saves $400-460/mo), adding dayparting (-$79/mo), desktop adjustments (-$82/mo), Saturday reduction (-$80/mo), and eliminating irrelevant search terms, we can recover 52-64% of the current budget. At a corrected $1K/mo with proper targeting, the campaign should generate 15-25 quality registrations from actual local buyers.
